title: Partition around a pivot, then recurse
invariant: During a partition of [lo,hi], values[lo:store] are smaller than the pivot and values[store:scan+1] are not smaller.

frames.explanation: Sort [4,7,2,6,3] by picking a pivot, putting smaller values to its left, and then sorting each side the same way.

scene.description: Quicksort normal: start, values [4,7,2,6,3], pivot -, store -, scan -.

frames.explanation: Sort the range [0, 4]. Its last value, 3, is the pivot. store = 0 marks where the next smaller value goes.

scene.description: Quicksort normal: pivot, values [4,7,2,6,3], pivot 3, store 0, scan -.

labels.text: gold = smaller than pivot; plain = not smaller; gray = outside range

frames.explanation: 4 is not smaller than 3, so leave it where it is.

scene.description: Quicksort normal: not-smaller, values [4,7,2,6,3], pivot 3, store 0, scan 0.

labels.text: gold = smaller than pivot; plain = not smaller; gray = outside range

frames.explanation: 7 is not smaller than 3, so leave it where it is.

scene.description: Quicksort normal: not-smaller, values [4,7,2,6,3], pivot 3, store 0, scan 1.

labels.text: gold = smaller than pivot; plain = not smaller; gray = outside range

frames.explanation: 2 is smaller than 3, so swap it into the store spot and move store to 1. Everything left of store is smaller than the pivot.

scene.description: Quicksort normal: smaller, values [2,7,4,6,3], pivot 3, store 1, scan 2.

labels.text: gold = smaller than pivot; plain = not smaller; gray = outside range

frames.explanation: 6 is not smaller than 3, so leave it where it is.

scene.description: Quicksort normal: not-smaller, values [2,7,4,6,3], pivot 3, store 1, scan 3.

labels.text: gold = smaller than pivot; plain = not smaller; gray = outside range

frames.explanation: Swap the pivot 3 into index 1. Smaller values are on its left, the rest on its right, so 3 is now in its final spot.

scene.description: Quicksort normal: place, values [2,3,4,6,7], pivot 3, store 1, scan -.

labels.text: gold = smaller than pivot; plain = not smaller; gray = outside range

frames.explanation: Sort the range [2, 4]. Its last value, 7, is the pivot. store = 2 marks where the next smaller value goes.

scene.description: Quicksort normal: pivot, values [2,3,4,6,7], pivot 7, store 2, scan -.

labels.text: gold = smaller than pivot; plain = not smaller; gray = outside range

frames.explanation: 4 is smaller than 7, so swap it into the store spot and move store to 3. Everything left of store is smaller than the pivot.

scene.description: Quicksort normal: smaller, values [2,3,4,6,7], pivot 7, store 3, scan 2.

labels.text: gold = smaller than pivot; plain = not smaller; gray = outside range

frames.explanation: 6 is smaller than 7, so swap it into the store spot and move store to 4. Everything left of store is smaller than the pivot.

scene.description: Quicksort normal: smaller, values [2,3,4,6,7], pivot 7, store 4, scan 3.

labels.text: gold = smaller than pivot; plain = not smaller; gray = outside range

frames.explanation: Swap the pivot 7 into index 4. Smaller values are on its left, the rest on its right, so 7 is now in its final spot.

scene.description: Quicksort normal: place, values [2,3,4,6,7], pivot 7, store 4, scan -.

labels.text: gold = smaller than pivot; plain = not smaller; gray = outside range

frames.explanation: Sort the range [2, 3]. Its last value, 6, is the pivot. store = 2 marks where the next smaller value goes.

scene.description: Quicksort normal: pivot, values [2,3,4,6,7], pivot 6, store 2, scan -.

labels.text: gold = smaller than pivot; plain = not smaller; gray = outside range

frames.explanation: 4 is smaller than 6, so swap it into the store spot and move store to 3. Everything left of store is smaller than the pivot.

scene.description: Quicksort normal: smaller, values [2,3,4,6,7], pivot 6, store 3, scan 2.

labels.text: gold = smaller than pivot; plain = not smaller; gray = outside range

frames.explanation: Swap the pivot 6 into index 3. Smaller values are on its left, the rest on its right, so 6 is now in its final spot.

scene.description: Quicksort normal: place, values [2,3,4,6,7], pivot 6, store 3, scan -.

labels.text: gold = smaller than pivot; plain = not smaller; gray = outside range

frames.explanation: Every pivot landed in its final spot: [2,3,4,6,7].

scene.description: Quicksort normal: done, values [2,3,4,6,7], pivot -, store -, scan -.

frames.explanation: Sort [2,2,2] by picking a pivot, putting smaller values to its left, and then sorting each side the same way.

scene.description: Quicksort edge-all-equal: start, values [2,2,2], pivot -, store -, scan -.

frames.explanation: Sort the range [0, 2]. Its last value, 2, is the pivot. store = 0 marks where the next smaller value goes.

scene.description: Quicksort edge-all-equal: pivot, values [2,2,2], pivot 2, store 0, scan -.

labels.text: gold = smaller than pivot; plain = not smaller; gray = outside range

frames.explanation: 2 is not smaller than 2, so leave it where it is.

scene.description: Quicksort edge-all-equal: not-smaller, values [2,2,2], pivot 2, store 0, scan 0.

labels.text: gold = smaller than pivot; plain = not smaller; gray = outside range

frames.explanation: 2 is not smaller than 2, so leave it where it is.

scene.description: Quicksort edge-all-equal: not-smaller, values [2,2,2], pivot 2, store 0, scan 1.

labels.text: gold = smaller than pivot; plain = not smaller; gray = outside range

frames.explanation: Swap the pivot 2 into index 0. Smaller values are on its left, the rest on its right, so 2 is now in its final spot. Nothing was smaller, so the next range is just one shorter. With many equal values this happens every time, and the sort slows to O(n²).

scene.description: Quicksort edge-all-equal: place, values [2,2,2], pivot 2, store 0, scan -.

labels.text: gold = smaller than pivot; plain = not smaller; gray = outside range

frames.explanation: Sort the range [1, 2]. Its last value, 2, is the pivot. store = 1 marks where the next smaller value goes.

labels.text: gold = smaller than pivot; plain = not smaller; gray = outside range

frames.explanation: 2 is not smaller than 2, so leave it where it is.

scene.description: Quicksort edge-all-equal: not-smaller, values [2,2,2], pivot 2, store 1, scan 1.

labels.text: gold = smaller than pivot; plain = not smaller; gray = outside range

frames.explanation: Swap the pivot 2 into index 1. Smaller values are on its left, the rest on its right, so 2 is now in its final spot. Nothing was smaller, so the next range is just one shorter. With many equal values this happens every time, and the sort slows to O(n²).

scene.description: Quicksort edge-all-equal: place, values [2,2,2], pivot 2, store 1, scan -.

labels.text: gold = smaller than pivot; plain = not smaller; gray = outside range

frames.explanation: Every pivot landed in its final spot: [2,2,2].

scene.description: Quicksort edge-all-equal: done, values [2,2,2], pivot -, store -, scan -.
